content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Thanks for your support. I have another question: if I purchase the latest version, will older expansion modules still function, or do they also need to be updated? Thank you, [user_name]
A new question from [user_name] has been separated into its own thread, titled 'What features besides the custom Web Server exist after upgrade?'. Best regards, [user_name]

Updated expansion modules were introduced for the [product_name] device series. Only expansion modules with an order number ending in [article_no] are compatible with the main modules of the [product_name] series due to mechanical differences. Older expansion modules with order numbers ending in [article_no] or [article_no] cannot be used and are incompatible.

Hello, That's unfortunate news, as I was planning to buy a new CPU and connect my existing expansions. Now, if I need additional expansion modules, I'll have to look for them in less conventional markets, like online auction sites. This upgrade situation is more challenging than I expected. Thanks so much for your helpful feedback. [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are disappointed by the incompatibility between newer and older expansion modules for [product_name] devices. Upgrading to the latest version means older modules cannot be reused, resulting in unforeseen expenses and difficulty in finding compatible hardware. Mechanical differences were unexpected, making system upgrades and expansions more complicated.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish that new [product_name] versions would remain compatible with previous expansion modules, ensuring their existing investments are protected and making the upgrade process more seamless.
